caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object that resembles a lantern. The body of the lantern is composed of an off-white or light gray pleated or ribbed material, appearing accordion-like with multiple evenly spaced horizontal ridges. The top and bottom are capped with circular, metallic-looking rims, shaded in gray to suggest a metallic texture. The top features a textured, dotted surface, and a looped metallic handle is attached at the center, comprised of two upward-curving supports meeting at a circular ring. The drawing is rendered on a beige background with no additional objects or details present. In the bottom right corner, the name "Edith Miller" is inscribed in small, neat lettering.
title: Lantern
